Master.Welcome.other:
👋 Hello! I'll help you create a bot for online booking of your clients.

🎯 What you'll get:
• A personal bot with your name (@your_name_bot)
• Clients book themselves — you just confirm
• Calendar, services and prices — everything is customizable
• Notifications about new bookings right in Telegram
• 🎁 All features are free

⏱ Setup takes 2 minutes.

📝 First step — create a bot in Telegram:

1. Open @BotFather (click the link)
2. Send the /newbot command
3. Enter a name (e.g. "Specialist John")
4. Enter a username (e.g. specialist_john_bot)
5. Copy the token — a long string of numbers and letters

Send me your bot token:

Master.Help.other:
🤖 This bot helps you launch and maintain your client-booking bot.

Available commands:
/start — Open the main menu

Use the menu to create a bot, read the FAQ, or contact an operator.

Each specialist gets a dedicated bot with a Mini App — clients book themselves, reminders are sent automatically, and visit history is tracked. Tap Start to create your bot in just a couple of minutes.

👋 Hi! I'll help you launch your own Telegram bot for online client bookings.

What your bot does:

🎁 All features are free:

MasterInvite.ShareText.other: Hey! I take client bookings through Telegram — a handy mini-app for specialists. Create your own bot:

MasterInvite.NotRegistered.other: To get your invite link, create your own bot first.

MasterFAQ.BotHow.other: 🤖 How to create a bot via BotFather Don't worry — it takes 2 minutes and our operator can help at any step. 1. Open @BotFather in Telegram 2. Send /newbot 3. Pick a name for the bot (e.g. "Ivan — massage") 4. Pick a username ending in bot (e.g. ivan_massage_bot) 5. Copy the long token BotFather sends you 6. Come back here, tap "🤖 Create my bot" and paste the token Stuck? Tap "💬 Talk to operator" and we'll walk you through it.

MasterFAQ.Usage.other: 📱 How to use the service • After registration you get your own bot — share its link with clients. • Set up your services, prices and schedule in the mini-app. • Clients open the bot and book themselves: date, duration, time. • You get a notification and confirm or decline with a single button. • Inside: calendar, client base, visit history, and reminders.

MasterFAQ.Cost.other: 🎁 How much it costs Nothing. The service is free, and every specialist gets all features from day one: • Clients book themselves through your bot • Recurring bookings • Prepaid passes (session packages) • Bulk scheduling tools • Revenue and workload analytics

MasterFAQ.Referral.other: 🤝 How to invite a colleague Tap «🤝 Invite a colleague» in the menu and send your personal link to a fellow specialist.

MasterFAQ.Token.other: 🔑 Replace token & help If your bot token stopped working or you recreated the bot in BotFather — send /replacetoken and follow the steps. For anything else, tap «💬 Talk to operator» — we're here.

MasterSupport.Welcome.other: 💬 You're connected to an operator Describe your question — we'll reply right here. Text, photos, voice messages and documents all work. To end the chat, just stop replying — you can come back any time.

MasterSupport.TooLong.other: ⚠️ That message is too long. Please trim it and send again.

MasterReplace.Prompt.other:
🔑 Replace token for @%s

⚠️ Use this only if you know what you are doing. This is an advanced recovery action for a bot you already own.

Open @BotFather → /mybots → pick your bot → API Token → /revoke if needed, then send me the new long token.

Send /cancel to abort.

MasterReplace.UsernameMismatch.other:
❌ That token belongs to a different bot (@%s instead of @%s).

Please send a token for *your* bot — I won't let you swap credentials between bots.

MasterReplace.Success.other: ✅ Token replaced. @%s is live again — you can share /start with clients.
